'''Arl'Toral''' was an ancient [[Coynite/Legends|Coynite]] warrior, son of the influential leader [[Toral]]. He acted in his father's stead to further improve the welfare of Coynite society. He revised and reformed the [[En'Tra'Sol]] law system laid down by his father, eventually forming a rigid code of conduct for all to adhere to. He also established the first [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] unit, the [[Mercenary Guild of Coyn/Legends|Mercenary Guild of Coyn]]. He brought peace to the once-troubled [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coyn]].
